snippet.title: HUNT BOSSES & SAIL THE SEAS! Co-Op Action RPG — Triarchy
snippet.description:
Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses. Play Triarchy your way! Activate Boss Challenge Modes or enable Assists to suit your playstyle. Open-world, Co-op, Action Adventure (1-3 Players)

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708040/Triarchy/?utm_source=triarchyannouncetrailer

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/kncEnAvPma
